No. 18/313,668 Atty Docket No.: BHD-4439-0411 March 10, 2025 Page 6 REMARKSBy way of the amendment instructions above, each of the independent claims 1 and 8 has been amended so as to change "the planar nut plate assemblies" to "the floating nut plate assemblies" which finds proper antecedent basis in each claim.Since the proposed amendments relate merely to form and address an apparent antecedent basis issue with respect to the allowed claims, their entry under the provisions of 37 CFR §1.312 is therefore in order.Fee Authorization No fee is believed to be required by this submission. However, should Office personnel deem otherwise, then the Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency, or credit any overpayment, in the fee(s) filed, or asserted to be filed, or which should have been filed herewith (or with any paper hereafter filed in this application by this firm) to our Account No. 14-1140.Respectfully submitted, NIXON & VANDERHYE P.C.By: /Bryan H.
